scopeNote: Track this permit application and its conditions. Permanent residence requires a separate eligible pathway and decision. Community averages combine applications within this guide and are not IRCC processing estimates.

relatedPathways.label: Canadian Experience Class
relatedPathways.description: Qualifying Canadian work may support CEC eligibility. Work gained while studying full-time does not count toward the CEC minimum. Meeting eligibility does not guarantee an invitation.

relatedPathways.label: Provincial nominee programs
relatedPathways.description: Check the province’s current stream rules, selection process and settlement-intent requirements. A permit alone does not qualify you for nomination or guarantee PR.

steps.title: Identify the exact LMIA exemption
steps.description: Confirm the exemption category and any special instructions using IRCC’s permit finder. LMIA exemption still requires eligibility for the applicable work permit.

requiredDocuments.title: Exemption evidence
requiredDocuments.condition: Include when required by your IRCC checklist or the linked instructions.

preparationChecklist.text: Keep the exemption category and supporting evidence.

steps.title: Confirm employer submission and support
steps.description: Have the employer complete the required IMP steps, including the offer submission and compliance fee unless exempt. Obtain the offer number or evidence of the applicable exception.

steps.title: Choose the correct application instructions
steps.description: Use the inside-Canada or outside-Canada process that applies to your eligibility. Merely being in Canada does not qualify you for an in-Canada application.

preparationChecklist.text: Check the rules for your current location and status.

steps.description: Follow requests for biometrics, medical checks or further evidence. Verify your existing work authorization while waiting.

steps.title: Receive approval and review conditions
steps.description: Follow the instructions for receiving your permit. For an overseas approval, the letter of introduction is not the work permit; entry and issuance are assessed at arrival.

steps.title: Plan status and future pathways
steps.description: Keep your status valid and review any future application before expiry. Canadian study or work can be relevant to some PR programs, but a permit does not grant permanent residence.

preparationChecklist.text: Review the related pathways and their individual eligibility rules.
